Remove a dialect.

## Usage

```text
rootform remove <object> [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ` -h, --help ` | ` bool ` | ` false ` | show how to use rootform remove |

## Behavior

Remove an installed dialect from this machine.

## Subcommands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [` rootform remove dialect `](remove/dialect.md) | Remove a dialect |

## Examples

```sh

```
